ideas.pitch: An autonomous IoT and AI-driven monitoring platform using Gemini and time-series DBs to detect anomalies and optimize power consumption in institutional buildings.
ideas.title: Smart Campus Energy Grid Ops
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Best Software track by combining complex anomaly detection with practical campus infrastructure utility, mirroring winning patterns from similar IoT-AI hybrid hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight developer tool running on edge NPUs to review and audit low-level C code for microcontrollers without requiring cloud connectivity.
ideas.title: Offline NPU Code Reviewer for Embedded C
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages localized hardware acceleration concepts to stand out in the Best Software and Grand Prize categories by solving offline constraints.

ideas.pitch: A minimal out-of-order execution core snippet implemented on an FPGA to monitor mission-critical peripheral interruptions in real-time hardware setups.
ideas.title: Custom FPGA RISC-V Safety Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Best Hardware track with tangible Verilog code and FPGA synthesis, appealing to judges looking for hard engineering feats.

ideas.pitch: A low-cost robotic sorting prototype using computer vision and Arduino microcontrollers to automatically classify discarded electronic components.
ideas.title: Automated Campus E-Waste Segregator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges physical hardware assembly with computer vision, fitting cleanly into the Best Hardware track through a working physical prototype.

ideas.pitch: A localized IoT sensor mesh dashboard that aggregates pH, turbidity, and flow rate data to predict contamination events in local water tanks.
ideas.title: Eco-Campus Smart Water Quality Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines responsive web design with sensor data pipelines, giving it a strong edge in both the Best Design and Best Software tracks.
